[[Category:Weapons that grant their own proficiency]]

enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Shield Proficiency: Tower Shield: While equipped this item grants the feat Shield Proficiency: Tower Shields.

Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver): This item could be upgraded if you found a Seal of the Stormreaver to combine it with. Bring this item to the Stormreaver Monument in Gianthold and combine it with a Seal of the Stormreaver to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

children.tooltip: Improved Bashing: This shield does an additional 2 to 12 damage when used to shield bash.
Shield Bashing +10%: +10% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
